name: low_52w_bounce_loose
thesis: A looser band than the two incumbent 52-week-low strategies, to test whether casting a wider net for laggards still works when the broad market is grinding higher.

name: low_52w_bounce_mid
thesis: A middle-ground proximity-to-low band between the two incumbents (1.015 tight / 1.08 loose) to triangulate whether the sweet spot is somewhere in between.

name: low_52w_bounce_tight
thesis: Tighter proximity to the 52-week low is a higher-conviction capitulation signal than the incumbent's 3% band; long hold since these are slow-grinding reversals, not quick bounces.

name: relative_strength_spy_long
thesis: A longer 6-month lookback with a higher outperformance bar for more durable leaders, held longer to let sustained relative strength keep compounding in a trending tape.
